title: protocol_processor_top.sv uses 44 identifiers before declaration: Vivado's analysis front-end rejects the module (xsim ineligible)
body:
Found while integrating the `44489453` pin into kebag-logic/milan-fpga (its PR #227, issue #69). Not a functional defect: everything synthesizes and every suite is green at this pin, including the 14,720-check `scripts/run_suites.sh` sweep. It is a front-end portability defect, and the integrator's tooling is where it bites.

## What Vivado reports

`protocol_processor_top.sv` uses identifiers before their declaration. Vivado 2026.1 out-of-context synthesis of `KL_pp_shadow` (the integrator's wrapper around `protocol_processor_top`) over the derived source list:

| pin | `Synth 8-6901` occurrences | distinct identifiers |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `a25b5cc9` | 37: 35 in `protocol_processor_top.sv`, 2 in `KL_pp_rx_validator.sv` | 36 |
| `44489453` | 51: 44 in `protocol_processor_top.sv`, 3 in `KL_aecp_notify.sv`, 2 in `KL_pp_rx_validator.sv`, 2 in `KL_pp_originator.sv` | 48 |

Warning text: `WARNING: [Synth 8-6901] identifier 'ntfy_prng_req_w' is used before its declaration [.../hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:2519]`.

The twelve identifiers new at `44489453` are the notification monitor and PRNG handshakes and the originator's cancel path: `ntfy_prng_req_w`, `ntfy_prng_kind_w`, `ntfy_prng_busy_w`, `ntfy_prng_valid_w`, `ntfy_mon_arm_valid_w`, `ntfy_mon_arm_slot_w`, `ntfy_mon_arm_owner_w`, `ntfy_mon_arm_deadline_w`, `ntfy_mon_arm_cancel_w`, `cancel_hit_w`, `cancel_ix_w`, `pd_ix_w`.

## Why it is worth fixing rather than tolerating

`synth_design` only warns, so a bitstream builds. Vivado's **analysis** front-end does not: `xvlog -sv` rejects the same construct with

```
ERROR: [VRFC 10-3380] identifier 'x' is used before its declaration
ERROR: [VRFC 10-8530] module '<m>' is ignored due to previous errors
```

and a module that is ignored is ineligible for the `xsim` benches. Verilator, `sv2v` and Yosys all accept it silently, so a bar built on that family cannot see it. The integrator hit exactly this in its own RTL and built a gate for it (kebag-logic/milan-fpga#132, cleared in #193); that gate reads the parent tree only, which is why this surfaced through a synthesis log rather than a gate. The integrator is deciding separately whether to extend it over the pinned submodules.

## Fix

Move each declaration above its first use. It is a mechanical reordering with no behavioural change -- these are all `logic`/`wire` declarations in the same always-comb or continuous-assign region as their use.

A cheap gate for the future, if useful: `xvlog -sv` over the module list, packages first, one module per invocation (analysis only, a few seconds per file, no elaboration and no instances needed). The integrator's `scripts/xvlog_gate.py` is that shape and is MIT-compatible in spirit -- happy to point at it or port it.

## Verification

- [ ] `xvlog -sv` analyses every module under `hdl/` with rc 0 and no `VRFC 10-3380`.
- [ ] Vivado synthesis of `KL_pp_shadow` over the derived list reports zero `Synth 8-6901`.
- [ ] The existing suites stay green (they are: 14,720 checks, 0 failing at `44489453`).
